OptionName: Amend I11 - bounded SECURITY DEFINER carve-out
Proposal: Amend I11 (ADR-002 section 5) to add a bounded, registered-bypass carve-out for enumerated SECURITY DEFINER functions (security.fn_register_user, security.fn_authenticate, security.fn_reset_password, security.fn_verify_email, system.fn_* listed, committee.fn_*, documents.fn_get_certificate_verification) with a registration/detection requirement.
ConstitutionalImpact: I11 invariant text changes; carve-out becomes part of the constitution; R1 I11 rule text updated; I11 classification revised from Present-Partial to explicit.
RequiresException: Possibly transitional while the amendment is in force
Advantages: Makes the invariant truthful about the accepted baseline; removes the permanent 'violation' label; strongest constitutional hygiene; aligns invariant text with repository state (REPOSITORY FACT 27/15/15/14/14/13 occurrences).
Disadvantages: Largest frozen-text change; requires careful carve-out wording to avoid legitimizing future unbounded bypasses; precedent-authorization risk (stress test section 3: 'the precedent authorizes future SECURITY DEFINER workarounds') must be neutralized by an explicit narrow-scope clause; needs the precedence rule with P3/I5 anyway.
RecommendationLevel: Recommended only if board wants text-truthfulness; not the minimal-risk path

OptionName: Amend P3/I5 - scope the authoritative-model home
Proposal: Amend P3 (ADR-002 section 3) and/or I5 (section 5) to scope the single-authoritative-model requirement: the aggregate model is the semantic home; RLS policies are its enforcement expression.
ConstitutionalImpact: P3/I5 text changes; RULE 12 semantic ownership assigned to DOMAIN_MODEL A02/A09; RLS home recharacterized as enforcement, not ownership.
RequiresException: Yes - still needed for the existing SECURITY DEFINER bypass (exception governs the deviation, not the conflict)
Advantages: Resolves the P3-I11 conflict at the source; makes DOMAIN_MODEL authoritative for RULE 12 semantics; consistent with DOMAIN_MODEL V8 and stress-test requirement for a precedence rule.
Disadvantages: Does not by itself legitimize the existing bypass (C6-C still required); amendment wording must not weaken P3's anti-scattering intent; must add the precedence rule between P3/I5 and I11.

OptionName: Formal constitutional exception for SECURITY DEFINER precedent
Proposal: Record the I11 exception in R9 (id, targetElement=I11, authority=ADR-003+, scope, expiry, status=Recorded) without amending I11 text; I11 moves to Suspended for the exception scope/expiry (state-machine transition 10).
ConstitutionalImpact: I11 state transition Violated -> Suspended for the exception's scope/expiry; R9 EXCEPTIONS populated; KNOWN_PRECEDENTS updated to reference ADR; EL-3 standing violation lifted for the bounded scope.
RequiresException: Yes - the exception itself (R9 record; SPEC-EXCEPTION shape)
Advantages: Necessary to govern the existing deviation; minimal frozen-text change; required by DECISION-P3-001 C6, ADR-INDEX PQ-2, closure report section 2.
Disadvantages: Alone it is NOT sufficient for Phase 4: Suspended I11 still cannot bind a gate (GD-2); does not resolve the P3-I11 conflict (an exception cannot reconcile two frozen rules); scope must be fixed by the board (recorded precedent says 'registration only' but repository surface is 27/15/15/14/14/13 occurrences); expiry must be set (currently 'Not defined').
RecommendationLevel: Necessary component of any C6 resolution

OptionName: Clarify semantic ownership vs enforcement location
Proposal: ADR records the interpretation: the aggregate model (DOMAIN_MODEL A02/A09) owns RULE 12 semantics; RLS policies enforce that matrix. No genuine conflict remains after the precedence statement; no P3/I5 text change required.
ConstitutionalImpact: No frozen text change; ADR records the precedence rule (stress-test section 6; AEM section 5 failure 1: Missing governance + Missing rule).
RequiresAmendment: No - interpretation recorded in ADR only
RequiresException: Yes - still needed for the existing SECURITY DEFINER bypass
Advantages: Lowest frozen-text churn; directly answers the stress test's 'no precedence between a principle and an invariant'; matches DOMAIN_MODEL V8 framing; keeps I11 text intact.
Disadvantages: If the board rejects the semantic-vs-enforcement reading, an amendment becomes necessary; the interpretation must be unambiguous to be enforceable; pairs with C6-C.
